title: Globulation 2 storefront-v2 gameplay trailer
made: 2026-11-27: re-recorded in real time on master with the game's own recorder (the 2026-11-24 tick-stepped trailer is at commit history)

build.label: master at 46ef8e2276 (Release 0.11.9.1, #1989), macOS release build made locally from that commit
build.note: Same source as the v0.11.9.1 release tag; built locally (tools/dev_build.py release=1 bundle), so the executable's bytes differ from the store builds. Its simulation is the one the 2026-11-24 matches ran: both matches replayed to the same final checksums (fsq-mix 2113040471, honeycomb 760558595).

capture_conditions.method: real time: the game's own gameplay recorder (--record, 30 fps, H.264 CRF 12 via VideoToolbox) in a real window, the match running at normal speed (30 ticks a second); frames extracted per tick from the recording's 30-tick chapters (capture_realtime.py)
capture_conditions.window: 3024x1666 physical pixels (the Retina screen, UI scale 1; the HUD is the same physical size as at UI scale 2 on the old 4256x2800 frames)
capture_conditions.renderer: portable-sdl in a real window (SDL's own renderer for that window, not the software renderer of off-screen runs)
capture_conditions.graphics: clouds and cloud shadows off; everything else default
capture_conditions.health_food_bars: off: the in-game 'draw information' toggle pressed once after each load (the L key on the capture Mac's Colemak layout types the bound 'i')
capture_conditions.zones: left as the colony's AI paints them and drawn as a player sees them (user decision 2026-11-27): no zones were erased
capture_conditions.framing: each shot keeps the old framing at 2/3 (or 0.6 for panning shots, 1.0 for the placement and co-play shots) of its old pixel size, with the in-game zoom scaled to match; camera pans are a sliding crop of the recorded frame in the edit; 1080p only
capture_conditions.recorder_drops: 0-1 frames dropped per take, all outside the cut; one held frame inside the cut in f-hero (frame 115, master 25.33 s): the game took longer than a frame on that tick, so two ticks show the same picture

footage_label: AI versus AI matches (spectator-equivalent). Every colony on screen is played by the game's own AIs from a headless all-AI match. Each shot is filmed from a local player seat that shares one colony with its AI (join-seat.py), so the camera, fog of war and interface are a real player's. The seat's only inputs are listed per shot: in the placement shot one Inn placed through the build palette; in the desktop co-play shot one Hive standing order installed over MCP by the editing agent. Recorded in real time at normal game speed. Not human-versus-human footage.
matches: headless matches and checkpoints under the desktop capture work directory; see ../captures/desktop/tools/matches.json for maps, seeds and AIs

music.track: Globulation 2 original soundtrack (content/data/zik/original: a2.opus building mood, a3.opus combat mood)
music.licence: GPL-3.0-or-later (content/data/zik and docs/assets/source-attribution.md in the game repository; in-game credits content/data/authors.txt)
music.use: the two moods share one timeline; the edit crossfades between them at the same playback position, as the game's SoundMixer does, and fades the tail. The combat mood (a3) is lifted 4 dB against the building mood so the fights do not read as a lull; a limiter at 4x oversampling keeps every file's true peak at or below -1 dBTP (measured per file under deliverables[].audio_loudness)

text.source: translations/<locale>.md fields trailer_line_1..4 and trailer_line_ai_coplay (desktop only)
text.renderer: headless Chromium (HarfBuzz shaping, ICU bidi) via render_cards.py; no ffmpeg drawtext
text.wordmark: glob2/content/data/gfx/menu-wordmark.png keyed into two masks, coloured cream and gold
text.placement: bottom of the frame over a scrim (landscape centre 80 % of the height, portrait 60 %); trailer_line_ai_coplay at the top of the frame (15 %) so the Hive card inset stays clear

storage.policy: Decided 2026-11-24 by the coordinating agent: the repository keeps this manifest, README.md, tools/, the posters, the contact sheets and the AppStream WebM (glob2-trailer-30s-1080p.webm, about 30 MB, committed because AppStream metadata needs a stable URL for it). The MP4 cuts (13 files, about 0.9 GB) are not committed; .gitignore in this folder ignores *.mp4.
storage.mp4_location: ../storefront-v2-renders/trailer/ relative to the repository root (/Users/bradley/glob2/storefront-v2-renders/trailer/ on the machine that made them)
storage.reproducible: Every MP4 is reproducible from the raw frames with tools/ (README.md, Reproduce). The bytes and SHA-256 under deliverables identify the exact files; they were re-checked against the moved files on 2026-11-24 and all matched.
storage.webm_url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Globulation2/glob2-marketing/main/assets/storefront/trailer/glob2-trailer-30s-1080p.webm (pin a commit hash in place of main for AppStream metainfo)
storage.store_packages: assets/storefront/store-packages/build.py links the per-store trailer files from both places (stores.json, trailer)
storage.note_2026_11_27: Re-recorded cuts are 1080p only (no 2160p files): the largest map window of a real-time take is 2560x1440. The previous cuts (with 2160p) moved to ../storefront-v2-renders/trailer-tick-stepped-2026-11-24/.
